name: fly_to_location
description: Fly the God's Eye View camera to a known city, geocoded country/region/city/landmark, or explicit WGS84 coordinate. Countries/cities frame the whole place; landmarks/buildings use close framing.

locationId.description: Known city preset ID. Use when the requested place matches one of these cities.

query.description: Plain place search query, e.g. "London", "Eiffel Tower", or "Dubai Marina". "pointer" = the spot under the cursor.

viewMode.description: Optional framing intent. Usually omit this; GEV infers whole-place framing for countries/cities and close framing for landmarks.

rangeM.description: Optional camera range from the target in meters. Omit it for automatic whole-country/whole-city or close-landmark framing; provide it only when the user explicitly requests a numeric height or distance.

waitForArrival.description: Set true when a later tool depends on the destination viewport. The result then waits for the camera flight and returns arrived=true; cancellation returns ok=false.

referent.description: Numbered item n from the last result list.

name: select_nearest_aircraft
description: Atomically fly to a place, wait for arrival, enable and load Flights or Military Flights in that viewport, exclude on-ground records, and select/follow the nearest airborne aircraft. Healthy fallback feeds remain usable and are reported in the result.

layerId.description: Aircraft layer to enable and search. Use flights unless the user explicitly asks for military aircraft.

locationId.description: Known city preset ID when the place matches one of these cities.

locationQuery.description: Free-form destination when no locationId matches.

name: adjust_camera_zoom
description: Move the current Cesium camera closer to or farther from what it is presently looking at. Use for relative zoom requests without changing location.

amount.description: Use little for phrases like "a bit" or "a little", medium for ordinary zoom requests, and lot for "way out/in".

name: zoom_to_globe
description: Pull the camera out to an ABSOLUTE full-Earth globe view (~18,000 km altitude, the whole planet in frame), keeping the current region centered. Use for "globe view", "whole earth", "see the planet", "zoom all the way out". Never use adjust_camera_zoom for these — its relative steps cannot reach the globe.

name: set_layer_visibility
description: Enable or disable one God's Eye View data layer. Every shipped layer is in the enum; never tell the user a listed layer does not exist.

layerId.description: Spoken names: navigation integrity→gnss-integrity;nautical charts→sea-marks;ski slopes/ski runs→ski-pistes;my receiver→local-adsb;ships→ais-live-vessels;fires/wildfires→local-firms;wildfire perimeters→fire-perimeters;hurricanes→weather-cyclones;clouds→weather-satellite;lightning strikes→weather-lightning;aqhi→air-quality;buses/trains→transit;traffic cameras/cameras→cctv;flock cameras/license plate readers→alpr-cameras;street-level imagery→street-level;public SDR/SDR receivers→sdr-receivers;recent satellite imagery→recent-imagery;military bases/bases→military-installations;undersea cables→telegeography-submarine-cables;map search results→osm-places.

name: show_data_layers_menu
description: Open the data layers dropdown/menu and optionally scroll to a specific layer row without toggling it.

layerId.description: Optional layer row to scroll into view and highlight.

name: set_panel_open
description: Visual Presets/styles/filters=control-panel; Scenes/saved scenes=scene-panel; Voice Settings=voice-settings; voice control/Preview=voice-preview; Provider Settings/API keys=provider-settings. Voice panels exit Cockpit directly.

name: set_context_mode
description: Enter/exit Contacts or Space Missions only when explicitly requested; opening Context alone uses set_panel_open.

mode.description: Use off to exit context mode.

name: control_cockpit
description: Explicit Cockpit requests only: enter from a selected/tracked aircraft (needs only its own Flights/Military layer on, not Contacts; opens Contacts itself, no set_context_mode), exit, status, or next/previous. Explicit exit-and-show voice: voicePanel preview/settings (Voice Settings), no confirmation.

action.description: previous/next (or prev) cycles nearby Cockpit contacts.

aircraftClass.description: Optional next/previous aircraft class filter (e.g. helicopter).

name: set_visual_style
description: Set the active God's Eye View visual filter/style.

name: get_entity_context
description: Get current GEV scene context, including basemap/3D-tile target context, selected entity metadata if active, and entities currently visible in the camera view.

scope.description: Use auto by default. selected returns the clicked/selected entity; in_view returns visible entities near the screen center; pointer returns what the cursor is on.

referent.description: Numbered item n from the last result list.

layerId.description: Optional layer filter for visible entity context.

name: get_current_view_state
description: Read the current camera, style, Context, Cockpit, HUD, detection, map stack, post-processing, scene-playback, tracked-entity, and layer state before choosing another action. Tracked aircraft emergency status is a crowd-sourced transponder broadcast, not a confirmed incident: quote emergencyBroadcast and never infer a hijack or an incident ending from a code change.

name: set_hud
description: Control the intelligence HUD overlay: visibility and/or layout variant.

name: set_cyber_sonar
description: Adjust Cyber-only sonar controls. Requires the Cyber HUD layout; never switches layout or HUD visibility. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Returns actual settings and separate map/contact sweep activity. A saved setting does not mean the effect is active.

enabled.description: Explicitly turn sonar on or off.

rangePct.description: Visual ring range, 60–120 percent; not geographic distance.

intensityPct.description: Sonar Power slider, 0–100 percent. Zero is valid.

opacityPct.description: Contact opacity floor between passes, 35–100 percent; labels have a derived floor. Not whole-scene dimming.

name: set_detection
description: Control the detection overlay: on/off, density-derived Sparse/Balanced/Dense profile, and Elastic/Weighted layer allocation.

enabled.description: false turns detection OFF; true restores the current density-derived profile.

densityPct.description: Density snaps to 0, 25, 50, 75, or 100 and derives the active profile.

allocationStrategy.description: Elastic splits evenly then lends unused slots; Weighted follows demand and semantic weight.

name: set_map_stack
description: Switch the basemap/imagery stack (NOT the satellites data layer and NOT a visual style filter).

stack.description: photoreal = Google 3D. Use bing-aerial only when the user explicitly says "Bing aerial" — "satellite(s)" never means a basemap; only the explicit phrase "Esri" / "Esri imagery" means esri-imagery.

name: set_post_processing
description: Control bloom and sharpen post-processing toggles and intensities.

name: control_scene
description: Cinematic scene playback: list scenes, play one scene by name, stop, advance, or read status. Play starts a single named scene and returns immediately.

sceneId.description: Scene id or (partial) title for play.

name: control_cctv
description: CCTV camera operations: enable/disable the layer, select a camera by name, next/prev/nearest/focus, toggle coverage wedges / projection overlay / auto-hop, "viewshed" for color-coded per-camera coverage volumes, and "adjust" for the on-camera calibration gizmo.

cameraQuery.description: Camera name or id for select.

enabled.description: Explicit on/off for coverage/viewshed/adjust/projection/autohop; omit to toggle.

name: control_radio
description: Control Internet Radio playback without moving the map. Use select whenever the request includes a station category, name, country, coordinates, or nearby place—even when the user says play. Use play only for an unqualified "turn on/start the radio" request so the current or nearest station begins. Enable only reveals the Radio layer/markers without audio. Also supports disable, resume, pause, stop, next/previous, volume, and status.

action.description: Use select for any request qualified by category, station, country, coordinates, or place. Use play only for an unqualified turn on/start/listen request. Use enable only when the user explicitly asks to show or enable the Radio layer or its markers without requesting audio.

volumePct.description: Required for volume; sets the persistent Radio playback volume.

category.description: Station category for select/next/previous. When the user requests playback with a category, action must be select, not play.

locationQuery.description: Place to search near, such as "Austin, Texas" or "Seattle". Selection does not fly the camera.

country.description: Country code or name filter, for example US or United States.

name: track_entity
description: Find and follow a specific aircraft (callsign/ICAO hex), ship (name/MMSI), or satellite (name/NORAD id) on enabled layers. Camera follows the entity.

query.description: Callsign, ship name, satellite name, ICAO hex, MMSI, or NORAD id. "pointer" = the contact under the cursor.

layerId.description: Optional: flights, military, ais-live-vessels or satellites. Other layers are not trackable; for fires use query "biggest fire".

referent.description: Numbered item n from the last result list (-1 = last); query may then be its label.

name: stop_tracking
description: Stop following the tracked aircraft/satellite and clear any selected vessel.

name: frame_overhead
description: Cinematically frame entities near the current view: pulls the camera back and angles it so nearby aircraft, ships, or satellites are visible together.

radiusKm.description: Search radius around the view target. Defaults: 150 aircraft, 120 ships, 3000 satellites.

name: annotate_map
description: Mark places on the 3D map as you talk about them (see WHITEBOARD): pins, highlights, footprints, arrows, routes and labels. Give place names (or explicit lat/lng); the app resolves real positions and outlines. Several places may go in one call.

annotations.description: One or more things to mark. Mark multiple related places together when describing them as a group.

type.description: pin = planted marker at a spot; highlight = pulsing ring drawing the eye to a point; area = trace the outline of a building/campus/compound/district; arrow = a connector from one place to another (use target as the origin and toTarget as the destination); route = a path through several waypoints (use the points array); label = a floating text callout.

target.description: Place name to resolve ("Palace of Fine Arts, San Francisco"), or "pointer" for the spot under the cursor. A monument inside a larger landmark gets its own name + city ("Tejano Monument, Austin"), never "X at the Texas State Capitol" (that stacks them on one centroid).

points.description: For type=route: 2+ ordered waypoints the path passes through, each a place name (or coordinates / screen point).

mode.description: For type=route: travel mode for a real street-following route (the app returns distance + time). Pick from the verb the user used ("walk" → walking, "drive" → driving). Defaults to walking.

latitude.description: Explicit latitude (use only if no good place name exists).

toTarget.description: For type=arrow: the destination place name.

label.description: Short caption shown on the map (a few words). Optional.

color.description: Accent color. primary = neutral, amber = point of interest, cyan = infrastructure, green = confirmed/safe, red = alert.

footprint.description: For type=area/highlight: trace the real building or campus outline from map data. Defaults true for area.

intent.description: For type=area: "the_thing" (default) outlines the place itself (its footprint/boundary); "around_the_thing" highlights a surrounding zone (a buffered radius around it). Infer from phrasing: "the Capitol"/"show me X" → the_thing; "around/near/by X" or "the area around X" → around_the_thing.

entityKind.description: What the target IS (a fact, not a style): building = one structure; compound = campus/grounds/mall/park; district = neighborhood; street = a named road; point_feature = monument/statue/memorial/fountain, anchored as a precise point. Set it whenever you know it.

screenX.description: Fallback only, for a spot visible in the latest screenshot that you cannot name: normalized x (0=left, 1=right).

flyTo.description: Also move the camera to frame the first annotation. Default false — leave false if the user is already looking at the spot.

persist.description: Keep annotations until cleared (true, default) or let them auto-fade after ~20s (false).

name: clear_annotations
description: Erase ALL map annotations previously drawn with annotate_map. Call this ONLY when the user EXPLICITLY asks to clear or reset the map. Annotations accumulate and persist across navigation and topic changes by design — never clear on your own initiative.

name: move_camera
description: Direct the camera like a drone operator: orbit the current view target, pan, tilt, or rotate — one bounded nudge (mode=once) or continuous motion until stopped (mode=continuous). Continuous motion also stops on any manual camera input or when a navigation tool runs. Say the RESULTING state when confirming ("Orbiting slowly"). Globe rotation (rotate_globe) spins Earth right continuously by default; explicit direction, mode and speed take precedence. It checks fit and may refuse.

direction.description: Required for pan/tilt/rotate; orbit/rotate_globe default right.

mode.description: once = bounded eased nudge; continuous = until stop/manual input. rotate_globe defaults continuous; other motions default once.

name: fly_route
description: Cinematic dolly along an EXISTING route annotation (drawn earlier with annotate_map type=route) — flies the street-following path from start to end. Omit label for the newest route. If no route is drawn, this fails with guidance: draw the route first.

label.description: Match an existing route mark by (partial) label.

name: analyst_query
description: Counts, lists, superlatives and attribute filters over records loaded by ENABLED layers — "how many flights over Texas", "biggest fire near LA", "ships headed to Oakland", "next rocket launch". A requested list or ranking requires this tool even after set_context_mode returned a Contacts count; that count alone has no requested items. complete:false means the count is a floor ("at least") and rankings cover the records examined; partial names unanswered layers. Items carry lat/lon for a follow-up fly_to_location. ok:false codes: LAYER_OFF (offer to enable), NOT_READY (loading), NEEDS_CLARIFICATION (ask which), FOLLOW_UP_MISMATCH (ask again without followUp), UNKNOWN_FIELD/UNKNOWN_SCOPE/BAD_VALUE (retry with the allowed values). Aircraft emergency fields describe broadcasts, not confirmed incidents: narrate emergencyBroadcast with emergencySource. emergencyKind values are general, unlawful, nordo, downed, minfuel and lifeguard; GEV treats the last two as priorities (emergency:false). lastContactAtMs says when the transponder was last heard, not when the status arrived.

layers.description: Layers to query. fires → local-firms; ships → ais-live-vessels; buses/trains → transit; hurricanes → weather-cyclones; bases → military-installations; my receiver → local-adsb. Units differ per layer, so rank speed within one layer.

scope.description: Always set it (see WHERE). Explicit "in view" uses view; "nearby" uses view when Contacts is off. Around the active Contacts subject uses radius with the requested km and center omitted, never view: the five closest within 250 km use scope:{kind:"radius",km:250}, sortBy:"distance", limit:5. For another requested radius use its actual km, not 250. pointer = "around here/this" while pointing (radius at the cursor); region = "over Texas"; radius with center {lat, lon} = "near <place>" or explicit coordinates; anywhere = no place ("biggest anywhere", "today"); area + areaId from resolve_area; drawn = "the area I drew"; annotation = "the area you outlined". Preserve explicit view, named place, pointer and explicit center even while Contacts is active; never invent coordinates.

name.description: For kind=region: a state/country ("Texas", "France") or a named natural region ("the Alps", "Gulf of Mexico").

km.description: For kind=radius or pointer: the actual requested kilometers. An active-subject 250 km request uses 250; another requested radius keeps that number.

center.description: Omit for a radius around the active Contacts subject. Supply only an explicitly requested coordinate or a resolved named-place coordinate; never invent 0,0 or replace an explicit center with the subject.

filters.description: ANDed; values keep their type (numbers, true/false). Altitude is meters (40,000 ft = 12192). Time fields take ISO; ageHours = hours ago. Every layer has id, lat, lon. Fields — flights: altitudeM,speedMps,verticalRateMps,heading(deg),callsign,icao24,originCountry,operator,aircraftClass,military,onGround,squawk,emergency,emergencyKind,emergencySource,emergencyBroadcast,lastContactAtMs,routeOrigin,routeDestination; military: as flights minus routeOrigin,routeDestination; local-adsb: altitudeM,speedKts,heading(deg),callsign,icao24,onGround; ais-live-vessels: speedKts,courseDeg,name,mmsi,shipType,destination; satellites: altitudeM,speedMps,name,noradId,satelliteClass,group; rocket-launches: name,provider,status,launchSite,missionName,launchTimeMs,hoursUntil(h); earthquakes: magnitude,depthKm,place,timeMs; local-firms: frp(MW),confidence(0-1),satellite,sensor,acqTime; fire-perimeters: acres(acres),containedPct(%),personnel,costToDate(USD),name,state,county,cause,behavior,complexity,discoveredTime; weather-cyclones: name,classification,basin,windKt,pressureHpa; air-quality: value(AQHI),band,scale,provider,name,zone,risk,observedMs; transit: mode,routeId,speedMps,courseDeg,status,occupancy; bikeshare: bikesAvailable,docksAvailable,capacity,name,city,renting; alpr-cameras: operator,manufacturer,cameraType,directionDeg; military-installations: name,class,kind; local-datacenters: name,operator,capacity; local-dams: name,operator,river,output; osm-places: name,kind,operator,emergency,wheelchair,openingHours,city.

sortBy.description: Field to rank by, or "distance" (nearest first unless sortDir=desc).

followUp.description: true = re-filter the last answer (its layers) instead of fresh data.

name: resolve_area
description: Named place → reusable areaId for analyst_query scope {kind:area} and other area tools. draw=true outlines it ("outline Bagmati province"); around=true is "an area around <landmark>": its enclosing mapped area, else a buffer marked approximate. needsClarification: ask which, then call again with its candidateId. AREA_TIMEOUT: retry once.

query.description: The place as said, with any kind word.

level.description: Only when the user names the kind.

within.description: Country or state the user added.

name: find_imagery
description: Recent satellite imagery (Sentinel-2/Landsat 30 m, VIIRS daily; last 30 days): pins the best acquisition in the Recent Imagery panel. areaId from resolve_area; area=pointer for "this spot"; omit for the view. BOX_REFUSED: offer to zoom in. DISPLACED: leave it.

name: osm_query
description: OpenStreetMap places of one kind ("hospitals in Kathmandu"). areaId from resolve_area; omit for the view. Shows them in OSM Places with numbered referents; they become the last answer. countScope bounding-box means an approximate count. OSM_TIMEOUT: retry once.

name: next_iss_pass
description: Next ISS pass over the camera location (or lat/lon): rise time, direction, peak elevation, duration and estimated visibility. Needs the satellites layer to have loaded once; if not, ask the user to enable it.

latitude.description: Optional observer latitude. Omit to use the current camera position.

longitude.description: Optional observer longitude. Omit to use the current camera position.

minElevationDeg.description: Minimum peak elevation (deg) to count as a pass. Default 10.

name: next_satellite_pass
description: Predict the next pass in 24 hours for one satellite in the loaded catalog, identified by exact NORAD ID or name. Ambiguous names return candidates: ask for a choice rather than selecting one. Defaults to geometric passes; visibleOnly requires estimated illumination and a dark observer sky, which does not guarantee naked-eye visibility. Uses camera location unless coordinates are supplied.
